**1) Horizontal overflow / clipped text?**
Yes. In the first screenshot, the hero headline is **clipped on the right edge** (the word *private* and the end of *financial stack* are cut off). The header text "elich Top. Privacy..." also appears to be overflowing or overlapping.

**2) Hero read clean with single CTA + text link?**
No. The provided screenshots **do not show any CTA button or text link** in the hero section—only the headline and body copy are visible.

**3) Big numerals 01-06 stacking correctly?**
Yes. The numerals (01, 02) are **stacking vertically** above their respective headings ("Confidential Lending", "Private Stablecoin") as expected for mobile.

**4) Any em-dash visible?**
No. There are **no em-dashes (—)** visible in either screenshot; only standard hyphens (e.g., in "USD-pegged") and commas are present.
